redfin.remarks: This is the 55+ unit you’ve been waiting for. This bright and airy unit features 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, two parking spaces, and an in-unit washer and dryer. The home is exceptionally clean and well-maintained. Complex amenities include a workout room , assigned storage unit , greenbelt , guest parking , and a community area. This is a wonderful opportunity to join a vibrant community in a central Torrance location . You are just minutes away from Wilson Park , Del Amo Fashion Center, Redondo Beach Pier, local markets, dining, and public transportation. Enjoy the best of South Bay living in a peaceful, well-kept community designed for comfort and convenience.
